body: Independent orchestrator review of PR #394 at the head the chain fetches after the update-branch onto the current main (the worker's head cb9c7bfa on e9bc99d2; task dotfiles-T129-doctor-sleep-disabled-a01, the overnight monitor's 22:40 JST item 2, dispatched to a005 at 13:50Z, amendment 1 at f7c8ffd8; branch doctor/sleep-disabled-a01): the diff adds scripts/check-sleep.sh (on macOS pmset -g must report SleepDisabled 1, else exit 1 naming the value and the pmset command; other OSes print the skipped line and exit 0), one recipe line in the Makefile's doctor target folding its status into tool_status, tests/unit/test_check_sleep.py (the one test with stub uname and pmset, red before the script and green after) and three fixture lines in tests/unit/test_runtime_health.py (the sleep script copied beside check-tools.sh in the three make-doctor fixtures; amendment 1, option A), plus the task's evidence directory; 36 changed lines outside tests (cap 60) and 64 under tests (cap 200); task copy f7c8ffd8 = the amended text; CI 13 of 13 on cb9c7bfa; Bot: no review and no comment within the 15-minute window after ready (the @codex review posted at 10 minutes unanswered); no P0/P1. The head the chain audits is the update-branch merge onto the current main; the PR shares test_runtime_health.py with PR #388 and merges after it.
